name: Invertible robust normalization
description: Invertible per-channel robust normalization (median/IQR) for forecasting inputs.

name: Causal lag/rolling features
description: Appends causal lag/rolling-mean channels for forecasting.

name: Rolling-median residual z-score
description: Robust residual + MAD z-score from a rolling-median baseline (anomaly features).

name: Rolling local slope (degradation)
description: Rolling local linear slope per channel (degradation/trend features).

name: Relevant-sensor channel selection
description: Selects the most relevant sensor channels (dimensionality reduction).

name: Weighted condition/health index
abs_sum_changes
description: Sum of absolute first differences (total variation).

name: amplitude
description: Computes half the difference between the maximum and the minimum magnitude.

name: augmented_dickey_fuller_p_value
description: Computes pvalue of augmented dickey fuller teststat.

name: augmented_dickey_fuller_used_lag
description: Computes usedlag of augmented dickey fuller teststat.

name: auto_correlation
description: Computes the auto correlation of the specified lags.

name: band_high
description: Spectral-energy fraction in the high band (2/3-1).

name: band_low
description: Spectral-energy fraction in the low band (0-1/3).

name: band_mid
description: Spectral-energy fraction in the mid band (1/3-2/3).

name: binned_entropy
description: Shannon entropy of a 10-bin value histogram.

name: burstiness
description: Computes burstiness statistic of a time series.

name: coefficient_variation
description: Computes coefficient of variation of order k is sigma^k / mu^k (for sigma, standard.

name: count
description: Computes length of an array, count on number of elements.

name: count_above_mean
description: Number of points above the mean.

name: count_below_mean
description: Number of points below the mean.

name: count_nan
description: Computes number of nans in an array.

name: cumsum_argmax_ratio
description: Relative position of the cumulative-sum peak.

name: cumsum_max
description: Maximum of the mean-centered cumulative sum.

name: distinct_ratio
description: Ratio of distinct values to length.

name: dominant_freq
description: Index of the dominant non-DC frequency.

name: dominant_freq_power
description: Power of the strongest non-DC frequency.

name: energy_ratio_first_half
description: Fraction of total energy in the first half.

name: fe_approx_entropy
description: Computes approximate entropy of x. (m=2, r=0.2)

name: fe_energy_ratio_chunk1
description: Computes energy ratio by chunks. (num_segments=10, segment_focus=1)

name: fe_quantile_10
description: Computes quartile of distribution in an array. (q=0.1)

name: fe_quantile_90
description: Computes quartile of distribution in an array. (q=0.9)

name: fe_ratio_beyond_2sigma
description: Computes ratio of values that are more than r*std(x)     (so r sigma) away from the mean of x. (r=2.0)

name: fe_ratio_beyond_3sigma
description: Computes ratio of values that are more than r*std(x)     (so r sigma) away from the mean of x. (r=3.0)

name: fft_aggregated_centroid
description: Computes the spectral centroid (mean) of the absolute fourier transform spectrum.

name: fft_aggregated_kurtosis
description: Computes the spectral kurtosis of the absolute fourier transform spectrum.

name: fft_aggregated_skew
description: Computes the spectral skew of the absolute fourier transform spectrum.

name: fft_aggregated_variance
description: Computes the spectral variance of the absolute fourier transform spectrum.

name: first_loc_max
description: Relative position (0-1) of the first maximum.

name: first_loc_min
description: Relative position of the first minimum.

name: flat_spots
description: Computes flat spots of an array.

name: flatline_fraction
description: Longest constant run as a fraction of length (cessation/quiet indicator).

name: g_skew
description: Computes median-based measure of the skew of an array.

name: has_duplicate
description: Computes if any value in x occurs more than once.

name: has_duplicate_max
description: Computes if the maximum value of x is observed more than once.

name: has_duplicate_min
description: Computes if the minimal value of x is observed more than once.

name: histogram_mode
description: Computes the mode of the data vector using histograms with a given number.

name: improved_burstiness
description: Computes improved burstiness statistic of a time series.

name: large_standard_deviation
description: Computes if std deviation is larger than r times diff of max and min.

name: last_loc_max
description: Relative position of the last maximum.

name: linear_trend_r
description: Pearson correlation of value vs time (trend strength).

name: longest_above_mean
description: Longest run of points above the mean.

name: longest_below_mean
description: Longest run of points below the mean.

name: longest_constant_run
description: Longest run of (near-)identical consecutive values (flatline length).

name: maximum
description: Computes maximum element of an array.

name: mean_abs_dev
description: Computes mean absolute deviation of an array.

name: mean_crossing_points
description: Computes mean crossing points of an array.

name: mean_outlier_test
description: Computes how distributional mean statistics depend on distributional outliers.

name: median_abs_dev
description: Computes median absolute deviation of an array.

name: median_crossing_points
description: Computes median crossing points of an array.

name: minimum
description: Computes min element of an array.

name: moments
description: Computes moment of the distribution of the input time series.

name: num_mean_crossings
description: Count of crossings of the mean level.

name: num_zero_crossings
description: Count of sign changes around zero.

name: outlier_segment_count
description: Computes the count of given number of consecutive measurements.

name: p_left
description: Computes distance from the mean at which a given proportion of data are more distant.

name: pair_slope_trend
description: Computes considering the last n (time-sorted) measurements of array,.

name: partial_auto_correlation
description: Computes the value of the partial autocorrelation function at the given lag.

name: past_value
description: Computes the head, i.e., oldest value in the window.

name: percent_amplitude
description: Computes percent amplitude of an array.

name: percentage_of_reoccurring_datapoints_to_all_datapoints
description: Computes the percentage of unique values, that are present more than once.

name: proportion_values_positive
description: Computes statistics the proportion of positive values.

name: proportion_values_zero
description: Computes statistics on the proportion of zeros,.

name: proportion_within_std_mean
description: Computes proportion of data points within p standard deviations of the mean.

name: proportion_within_std_median
description: Computes proportion of data points within p standard deviations of the mean.

name: quantile
description: Computes quartile of distribution in an array.

name: quantile_25
description: Computes first quartile of distribution in an array.

name: quantile_75
description: Computes third quartile of distribution in an array.

name: quarter_mean_diff
description: Mean of last quarter minus first quarter (drift).

name: ratio_above_mean
description: Fraction of points above the mean.

name: ratio_beyond_r_sigma
description: Computes ratio of values that are more than r*std(x)     (so r sigma) away from the mean of x.

name: ratio_unique_value_number_to_time_series_length
description: Computes a factor which is 1 if all values occur only once,.

name: slope
description: Linear trend slope over the window.

name: small_kurtosis
description: Computes small sample kurtosis of the array.

name: spectral_centroid
description: Center of mass of the frequency spectrum (brightness).

name: spectral_entropy
description: Entropy of the normalized power spectrum.

name: spectral_flatness
description: Geometric/arithmetic mean of spectrum (tonal vs noisy).

name: spectral_rolloff
description: Frequency below which 85% of spectral energy lies.

name: std_diff
description: Std of first differences (volatility of change).

name: std_outlier_test
description: Computes how distributional statistics depend on distributional outliers.

name: sum_of_reoccurring_data_points
description: Computes the sum of all values, that are present more than once.

name: sum_of_reoccurring_values
description: Computes the sum of all values, that are present more than once.

name: trimmed_mean
description: Computes mean of the trimmed time series using trim_mean.

name: unique_prop
description: Computes proportion of the time series that are unique values.

name: variance_larger_than_standard_deviation
description: Computes variable denoting if the variance of x is greater than its standard deviation.
